_comment_about_this_file: Firefox enterprise policies template.
Linux:   /etc/firefox/policies/policies.json
(or /usr/lib/firefox/distribution/policies.json)
macOS:   /Applications/Firefox.app/Contents/Resources/distribution/policies.json
Windows: HKLM\Software\Policies\Mozilla\Firefox  (registry-based)
OR  C:\Program Files\Mozilla Firefox\distribution\policies.json
The Firefox extension ID is `desktop-connector@sonomos.ai` (set in
manifest.json under browser_specific_settings.gecko.id). It keeps the
old product name because it is the id already registered for this
add-on; changing it would orphan every existing install.
There is ONE policies.json per machine and it is not merged key by
key with anything else, so this template deliberately sets only what
this extension needs. It used to also carry `DisableTelemetry` and
`DontCheckDefaultBrowser`, which are browser-wide settings unrelated
to Locke: pasted into a fleet that had already decided those
questions, they silently overrode that decision. Removed 2026-09-01.
For managed-storage values, Firefox does NOT read from the policies
file. Instead it reads a separate JSON file at:
Linux:   /etc/firefox/managed-storage/desktop-connector@sonomos.ai.json
macOS:   /Library/Application Support/Mozilla/ManagedStorage/desktop-connector@sonomos.ai.json
Windows: HKLM\Software\Mozilla\ManagedStorage\desktop-connector@sonomos.ai
See firefox-managed-storage.json in this directory for that file.
The install_url below points at the AMO slug this add-on has been
listed under in docs/store/LISTING.md (`locke-extension`). No release
has been published to AMO yet, so that URL does not resolve today;
confirm it against the live listing before you deploy this.
